title: Lateral bone augmentation in narrow posterior mandibles, description of a novel approach, and analysis of results
authors: Beitlitum I, Sebaoun A, Nemcovsky CE, Slutzkey S Clin Implant Dent Relat Res. 2018 Apr;20(2):96-101.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss maxgraft granules (processed human allograft) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The simplified membrane fixation procedure enable s large horizontal bone gain with minimal complications while allowing adequate implant placement” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
